worldcombat.skill.grasspledge.summary: Drive a Grass Pledge into chosen ground: a pillar of grass bursts up, pinning and slowing the enemies inside, and the base leaves a coiling pledge scar. If a fire or water pledge scar already lies near the point, the vows answer: the strike is far heavier and the ground becomes a sea of fire (grass + fire, which keeps burning those inside) or a wetland (grass + water, which roots and heavily slows those who step in).
worldcombat.skill.grasspledge.descriptio: The pillar bursts up at the chosen point, dealing about %1$s special damage to each of up to %2$s enemies inside.

The column is %1$s blocks in radius and %2$s blocks tall (a closer-bonded user grows it taller); anyone caught is pinned by roots for %3$s - unable to move but still able to act - and carries a %4$s slow (movement speed about 30%% lower).

The base leaves a coiling pledge scar, %1$s blocks in radius and lasting %2$s; enemies standing on it are continually slowed (movement speed about 30%% lower), and the slow fades within about 2 seconds of stepping off.

If a fire or water pledge scar lies within %1$s blocks, the two vows resonate: the strike's power is x%2$s and the ground grows a combined field whose radius is about %3$s times the scar's - a sea of fire (grass + fire) or a wetland (grass + water).
worldcombat.skill.grasspledge.entangle.o: Entangling vow: root duration x1.5, scar lifetime x0.8, combined-field radius x1.1 and cooldown +10, at the cost of pillar power x0.94.
Lush vow: pillar power x1.06, scar lifetime x1.2, combined-field radius x0.95 and a shorter cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.grasspledge.timing: Cast range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.grasspledge.use.0: Raise a grass pillar on distant ground and entangle
worldcombat.skill.grasspledge.use.1: Slow a patch of ground with a coiling pledge scar
worldcombat.skill.grasspledge.use.2: Combine with a fire or water pledge into a sea of fire or a wetland
worldcombat.skill.grasspledge.preference: On (entangling vow): root duration ×1.5, scar ×0.8, cooldown +10 — locks one target down. Off (lush vow): power ×1.06, scar ×1.2, shorter cooldown — hits harder and lingers longer.
The companion only raises a grass pillar while the threat is within this distance; beyond it, it closes in first.
worldcombat.skill.grasspledge.growth.0: From level %1$s the pillar gains another step with level (about %2$s).
worldcombat.skill.grasspledge.descriptio: A sea of fire keeps non-allies inside burning: while burned they lose about a sixteenth of their maximum health every 5 seconds (at least 1) and deal half physical damage. A wetland roots those who step in for about 1.5 seconds and keeps them heavily slowed (movement speed about 45% lower). The combined field lasts about 60% longer than the scar.
